About the job
 About V11
 V11 is an investment firm focused on growth-stage, venture-backed technology companies, investing on a deal-by-deal basis through dedicated investment vehicles (SPVs). We partner with family offices and qualified investors to provide access to select private market opportunities, with a focus on disciplined underwriting and selective deployment. 
 Role Overview
 We are seeking highly motivated individuals to support V11's research, ecosystem development, and relationship-building efforts.
 This is an opportunity for students and professionals interested in venture capital, private markets, startups, entrepreneurship, and emerging technologies to gain hands-on exposure to the investment ecosystem.
 Responsibilities
 • Conduct market and industry research.
• Map venture capital firms, family offices, and industry stakeholders.
• Support CRM management and relationship tracking.
• Assist with investor outreach initiatives.
• Monitor private market, venture capital, and technology trends.
• Support ecosystem-building efforts and strategic partnerships Preferred Qualifications.
 Preferred Qualifications
 • Strong interest in venture capital, private equity, startups, or technology.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Self-starter with strong attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
• Experience with research, business development, finance, or startups is a plus.
 What You Will Gain
 • Direct exposure to venture capital and private markets.
• Access to founders, investors, and industry professionals.
• Training on startup evaluation and market research.
• Experience working alongside an active investment platform.
• Opportunity to build a network within the venture ecosystem.
